name: ada-cli
title: Ada CLI
blurb: Ada CLI on GNAT: byte-exact counting core, hand-rolled argv parser, dependency-free test harness, output through two subprogram parameters

verify.name: stdin
verify.cmd:
test "$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }} -w)" = '3 -' && test "$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }})" = ' 2  4 23 -'

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd:
mkdir -p .parity && printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' > .parity/p1.txt && printf 'one two three' > .parity/p2.txt && printf 'h\303\251llo w\303\266rld
' > .parity/p3.txt && : > .parity/p4.txt && printf 'a	b\vc d
' > .parity/p5.txt && ok=0; for file in .parity/p*.txt; do ours=$(./bin/{{ npm_name }} -l -w -c "$file" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); theirs=$(wc -l -w -c < "$file" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); if [ "$ours" != "$theirs" ]; then echo "mismatch on $file: ours=$ours wc=$theirs"; ok=1; fi; done; test "$ok" -eq 0
